The <b>White Key</b> is an [[Items (Silksong)#Keys|item]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== Use ==
Used to unlock the lift at the entrance to the [[Whiteward]], allowing [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] to access the rest of the area.<ref>Inspecting the lock: <i>"A white lock bearing a surgical symbol."</i></ref>

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS White Key Use.png!Location in the Whiteward where the White Key can be used
|Image2 = Screenshot SS White Key 01.png!White Key lock
}}

{{Clear}}

== How to Acquire ==
The key is found on a [[Surgeon]]'s corpse at the far right edge of [[Songclave]] in the [[Choral Chambers]], if Songclave has not yet become a town. If it has, the <i>[[The Wandering Merchant]]</i> [[wish]] must first be granted, allowing the key to be purchased from [[Jubilana]] for {{R|220}}.<ref>Jubilana: <i>"Real fine key this. No doubt it'll open the way to somewhere special. Somewhere full of goodies, I'll bet. Find the lock, and it'll practically pay for itself!"</i></ref>
